scope_note: Two single-proposition corrections made by the controller acting as editor. In SG-MA-OUTSTATE-PRESCRIPTIONS, two places compressed clause (4) of the first further paragraph of M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 18(d1/2) so that 'that state's laws' read as the issuing state; the statute means the state the delivery reaches, which clause (6) fixes as the patient's state of residence. In SG-CONTROLLED-SCHEDULES, a table cell said temporary placement has no counterpart in 21 CFR part 1308; 1308.11(h) is that counterpart, and one additive rule, FED-TEMPORARY-SCHEDULE-LISTING, now carries it. Neither section had any other actionable scope signal.
